Name: Mayoba
Author: TheFrenchDodo
Description:
Replaces Yoba with Mayoba both visually and in dialogue & text.

Please note that this mod only alters vanilla dialogue & text.

List of visual changes:
The Sign Of The Vessel (Craftable) has been altered to depict a mayo jar.
The Shrine in Pierre's Shop is now a Shrine to Mayoba.
The Yoba Shirt is not the Mayoba shirt.
The Sign of the Vessel frame in the Clinic now shows a mayo jar.

And every instance of Yoba in text should now refer to Mayoba.

[b]Requirements:[/b]
This mod requires:
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
